name: goku
description: Browse PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and MongoDB databases and their ER diagrams, like the Goku app.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connections from workspace settings and .env files are only read in trusted workspaces.

goku.connections.markdownDescription: Connections, in the same shape as the Goku app's profiles (`name`, `kind`, `hosts`, `user`, `database`, `ssl`, `ssh`, `readOnly`, …). Never put passwords here: Goku asks for them and keeps them in VS Code's secret storage.

goku.envFiles.markdownDescription: Workspace files searched for `DATABASE_URL`, `MONGODB_URI`, `PG*` and similar variables. Connections found there are read-only by default.

goku.enginePath.markdownDescription: Path to a `goku-engine-server` to use instead of the bundled one (for engine development). Machine scope only, so a workspace can't point it at another program.
